ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, labeled with organisms such as Deer, Tiger, Plant, Goat, Snake, Eagle, Grasshopper, Mynah, etc. On the right side of the diagram there is an arrow from Snake pointing to Eagle, and after Eagle there is no arrow pointing to any other organism. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate from food or prey to predator. Eagle receives an arrow from Snake, indicating that Eagle preys on Snake; at the same time, the diagram does not show Eagle being preyed on by other organisms. Therefore, Eagle appears only as a predator.
